name: Revert Default Permission (RDP)
description: controls visibility of the 'Revert to defaults' button in Layout Builder.
project_description:
This module provides additional options for content entities within the Layout Builder in Drupal. It allows administrators to hide the "Revert to Default" button, ensuring users are unable to revert layouts to their default state. This feature is particularly useful in scenarios where customized layouts must be preserved, and any changes should not be overridden by reverting.

Features

 Hide the "Revert to Default" button for specific content entities.

 Installation 
 Download and enable the module as usual for Drupal.

 Configure the settings on the content entity where you want.

 Usage 
 Once installed, you can hide the "Revert to Default" option for content entities in the Edit interface. This prevents users from resetting layouts to their default state, helping to ensure that custom layouts are preserved.
